label: Every first mover moved by none really has every pure perfection among the supplied…, from infinity
description: Simplicity says a first mover's esse is not other than its essence; excluded middle gives equality; the existing q.7 reading STMT-SUBSISTENT-BEING-IS-INFINITE, a premise of the designated root route, makes it infinite; the open near-definitional bridge STMT-INFINITE-HAS-EVERY-PURE-PERFECTION gives it every pure perfection.
